# Buzbee Law Firm

> > Award-winning Texas personal injury law firm specializing in litigation for workplace accidents, maritime injuries, sexual abuse, and wrongful death cases with $10B+ in recovered settlements.

Buzbee Law Firm is a Houston-based litigation powerhouse led by Tony Buzbee, recognized nationally for handling high-profile cases including 150+ victims in the Sean Combs litigation. The firm focuses exclusively on trial-ready personal injury cases across Texas and maintains expertise in specialized areas like Jones Act maritime law, oil field accidents, and industrial workplace injuries.
